title: Australian worker wins A$17,861 after employer fails to consider vacant role before AI-linked redundancy
summary_full: An Australian contracts administrator faced dismissal as the employer attributed this to the reduced necessity for his role due to AI tools. However, after the employee filed an unfair dismissal claim, the Fair Work Commission awarded compensation, highlighting the employer's neglect in exploring redeployment options. While the redundancy was justified, the company failed to conduct a fair process, particularly as the employee had expressed interest in other roles.
